messages:
nina: Heads-up: users reported inconsistent timeout names in our docs. Found `timeout_seconds`, `deadlineMs`, `--timeout-secs`, and raw Go contexts. Confusing for quickstarts.

mira: Agreed. For copy/paste examples I prefer `timeout_ms` everywhere JS/Python/HTTP-facing snippets.

omar: Fine by me. For Go keep `context.WithTimeout` but add a one-line comment mapping it to `timeout_ms` (e.g., // equivalent to timeout_ms=3000).

sam: Streaming note: client-side timeout cancels the client read; the server may still finish generating tokens. We should add a short caveat in the streaming section and errref.

nina: Action plan: mira will open a PR to update quickstarts and errref conversions; omar will patch Go examples; sam will run snippet-lint and link-check. Target: ship by next Tue.

errbot: errbot: Created checklist: [ ] unify quickstarts to timeout_ms, [ ] add Go mapping comments, [ ] add streaming cancellation caveat to errref, [ ] run snippet-lint and link-check.

mira: Opening WIP PR now and will include a tiny conversion table: timeout_ms -> timeout_seconds (Python) -> context.WithTimeout (Go). Also adding a migration note: "Multiply seconds by 1000 to convert to timeout_ms; Retry-After remains seconds per HTTP spec."

sam: I'll watch the PR for embedded Gists; snippet-lint often misses Gists. If there are Gists we should copy snippet text inline or update the Gist.

omar: Also grep for `deadline` in docs/errref and examples; left comments where I found occurrences.

nina: Nice. If CI flags SDK param docs, add a short mapping in the SDK reference page so users can find the canonical param name.

mira: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2399 (WIP). Left TODO where Gist updates are required.

sam: Running local snippet-lint; found two remaining `deadlineMs` occurrences inside a Gist and one shell quickstart using `--timeout-secs`. I'll patch during review.

nina: Thanks. We'll finalise wording for the streaming caveat in the PR comments (keep it concise). Merge after sam's patches and passing link-check.
